description: Item price and freight must be non-negative
sql: SELECT * FROM items WHERE TRY_CAST(price AS DOUBLE)<0 OR TRY_CAST(freight_value AS DOUBLE)<0

description: Item amounts must parse as finite numbers
sql: SELECT * FROM items WHERE TRY_CAST(price AS DOUBLE) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(freight_value AS DOUBLE) IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(TRY_CAST(price AS DOUBLE)) OR NOT isfinite(TRY_CAST(freight_value AS DOUBLE))

description: Payments must be non-negative
sql: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE TRY_CAST(payment_value AS DOUBLE)<0

description: Payments must parse as finite numbers
sql: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE TRY_CAST(payment_value AS DOUBLE) IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(TRY_CAST(payment_value AS DOUBLE))

description: Purchase timestamps must be present and parseable
sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL

description: Delivery cannot precede purchase
sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE TRY_CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)<TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)

description: Delivered orders should have a valid customer-delivery timestamp
sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_status='delivered' AND TRY_CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL

description: Review score must be an integer from 1 to 5
sql: SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE TRY_CAST(review_score AS DOUBLE) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(review_score AS DOUBLE) NOT IN (1,2,3,4,5)

description: Orders without items require investigation
sql: SELECT o.order_id,o.order_status FROM orders o LEFT JOIN items i USING(order_id) WHERE i.order_id IS NULL

description: Aggregate items and payments separately; flag absolute differences above BRL 0.05
sql: WITH i AS(SELECT order_id,SUM(TRY_CAST(price AS DECIMAL(18,2))+TRY_CAST(freight_value AS DECIMAL(18,2))) expected_brl FROM items GROUP BY 1),p AS(SELECT order_id,SUM(TRY_CAST(payment_value AS DECIMAL(18,2))) actual_brl FROM payments GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(i.order_id,p.order_id) order_id,expected_brl,actual_brl,actual_brl-expected_brl delta_brl FROM i FULL OUTER JOIN p USING(order_id) WHERE expected_brl IS NULL OR actual_brl IS NULL OR ABS(actual_brl-expected_brl)>0.05
